name: Diffusers
tagline: A Python library for diffusion models and generative image, video, and audio pipelines.
hook: A shared guide to setup, approval-gated actions, self-review, publication boundaries, and focused model and testing references.
summary: Both root instruction files link to .ai/AGENTS.md. The guide covers setup, actions that need human approval, and which references or skills to read. Its self-review steps are shared with the project's CI reviewer.

techniques.title: Separate persistent references from task workflows
techniques.body: Model conventions, pipeline patterns, tests, and reporting each have a reference guide. Adding or converting a model is routed to a skill, distinguishing ongoing conventions from an end-to-end procedure.
techniques.quote: **Models** — see [models.md](references/models.md) for model conventions, attention pattern, implementation rules, dependencies, and gotchas. For adding or converting a model, use the [model-integration](skills/model-integration/SKILL.md) skill.

techniques.title: Make exact wording part of the approval boundary
techniques.body: Human review applies to commit messages, comments, docstrings, and public discussion as well as the PR description. The file asks whether the user will author the text or wants a draft, and separates preparing that draft from publishing it.
techniques.quote: Everything a PR reviewer sees must come from a human, or be approved by one for the exact wording.

techniques.title: Explain how old skill symlinks can alter the source
techniques.body: The setup section calls out a previous installation method that linked tool folders into .ai. Removing those links is necessary because a new install would otherwise write through them into the shared source directory.
techniques.quote:
Skills used to be installed through the `Makefile`, which symlinked the project-level `.claude/skills` and
`.agents/skills` at `.ai/skills` in this repo. Remove those links if they exist — otherwise the install writes through
them into `.ai/` itself:

techniques.title: Use the same review rules locally and in CI
techniques.body: The pre-PR self-review points at a named rules file and a dedicated skill. The guide states that the CI reviewer uses the same pass, giving local preparation a shared standard.
techniques.quote: The [self-review skill](skills/self-review/SKILL.md) runs this as the same pass the `@claude` CI reviewer uses.

steal: Separate reference conventions from procedural skill entry points.
State approval boundaries for each kind of published text.
Explain write-through hazards when changing a symlink-based setup.
Share the same review rules between local workflows and CI.
